responsibility: Coordinates enum and coroutine type debuginfo construction within the metadata layer by selecting between C-style, native DWARF variant-part, and C++-like encodings, and provides shared helpers for enumerator metadata, per-variant struct descriptions, and discriminant computation across those encodings.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the top-level `debuginfo/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is a specialized metadata submodule focused only on enum and coroutine type descriptions. It chooses and builds the debug type encoding for variants and discriminants, rather than owning the overall DIBuilder state or general debug variable/location emission.
